fusions.name: Plunging Point
fusions.desc: A thrown point that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Impaling Pass
fusions.desc: Sends a lance into the first enemy it meets that deals 11 damage and stuns it for 1 second. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Longer Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Thrown Rhythm
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, you restore 4 stamina and each kill restores 4 health. Once every 5 seconds.
